title: Pearl and Bullet Hole
subtitle: The kitty and puppy fight in the basket. Despite the constant grumbling, you know they actually don't hate each other.

trails.title: Trail ① Sotheby's Potion
trails.description: The Chew-Chew Hallucinogen II. Sotheby has all the ingredients you need.

items.text: Pearl and Bullet Hole

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Okay, it's time to publish the lab results of the 42nd trial of The Chew-Chew Hallucinogen III!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Tell me about what you saw?

items.speaker: Man In Black
items.text: The Madonna, dagger, Portland cement blocks ...  ahh yuck! It tastes like cement too.

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Wool, twine and scissors, pineapple cherry tomato pizza ...

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Oh no no no no. How sacrilegious ... my Lord!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Glenn Miller's trombone collection, medals ... and ...

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Why is that here—the body of my dog in the trench?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: ... Gosh! Really sorry, Mr. Karson ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Still need to improve, improve! It's alright. Give me more time. Thirty minutes are enough!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Turns out the "Storm Syndrome" can distort all the senses about foods ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Working up an appetite with hallucinogen is harder than I thought. Miss Sotheby, we have to hurry up.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The longer they can't eat, the weaker they get.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I know. I will make it ... I've learnt so many formulas ... and bought so many of the best ingredients ... I ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hey! Stop it, Anna! Don't eat these banknotes! Stop her, Ms. Sonetto!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Stono Swift!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sorry. For the humans who have temporarily lost their minds, this is the only way to go.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I received the message from the patrol team. Followers are around the manor.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What?! They must be doing something bad! Stop them. Don't let them in!
Edge, Manor

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What?! They must be doing something bad! Stop them. Don't let them in!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The rolling wind is not usual tonight.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Miss Sonetto, have you heard from the Foundation?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Not yet ... If the instructions are delayed, I am afraid I will implement the backup plan.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: To rescue the Timekeeper is the primary goal.

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: I'm afraid that reality fails you, ladies.

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: Say a bunch of people carrying a stretcher.

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: The person on the stretcher is tightly covered with a white cloth. Only one arm with the feather decoration hangs down.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Who are you!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The masks ... You are the trouble maker, Followers? Carrying a small white bed. What's that?

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: That black suit ... the feathers ...

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Schneider?! That's my sister Schneider! What happened ... the blood everywhere ...

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: What happened? Death, of course.

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: There are many bodies, she is the only one to go home. Just for you to know.

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: It's our Ms. Vertin's decision.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... Nonsense!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Let me check. The scar on her chest has no sign of slime ...

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: Ms. Vertin is already one of us. We share the same blood.

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: That's an incredible gunfight, greater than any you've seen last night. Believe it or not, check the scars on the body. They're like sparkling pearls on the beach.

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Oh … enough. Enough!!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Unforgivable! How could there be someone who spoke such rude words and ... insulted the deceased and the Timekeeper like this ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: May the peace be with us.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... The enemies are cleared.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Good fight, old woman.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... Huh!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: You venge me fiercely. ... *cough* ... Even my stone heart will be moved ...

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Sis?! You're alive ... Thank God ... Jesus and sweet Mary!

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Huh! What is going on? How did you get these bad injuries?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Where is the Timekeeper? What happened to you? Is ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Huh emm ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: These are not important. In your heart ... there has been an irrevocable answer for long.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Look at this flower. Look at every word on it ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: We got it at the expense of ... our lives ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: ... I'm so glad ... I can see the starry night.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: She passed out! Take her inside for emergency medical attention!
TO BE CONTINUED…
